segments.text: Trouble's just 9.9 seconds away with the Tata Nexon - and we're not talking about the in-laws
Under the hood, it's rocking an 81 kW power punch - no compact SUV is going to bully this one
And when you need to merge, 245 N⋅m of torque is like having the SUV equivalent of a sharp tongue - it gets you in, no questions asked
All this sass from a 1.5-litre engine - who needs a V8 when you can have efficiency and attitude?
For the best of both worlds, the Creative variant is the sweet spot - with a 360-degree camera, automatic climate control, alloy wheels, and cruise control, you'll be living large, not large-empty
But honestly, the biggest flex is not the car itself, but finding someone who can handle the fact you own one
So, are you Team Creative or do you have your eyes on another variant? Sound off in the comments, and don't forget to follow for more auto antics
